content.comment_body: Hello, I am using [article_no]. I do not utilize any online features or cloud connectivity within the programming software for the PLC, so I currently have no experience with that aspect. My question is: how can I demonstrate or verify that there is no cloud connection or link in use? My customer requires strict cyber security compliance. Thanks in advance for your assistance!

Hi [user_name], Here's what you can do to confirm there is no cloud connection: 1. Configuration Check: Ensure your [product_name] device isn't set up to connect to any cloud service. Review the settings in [product_name] programming software, confirming there are no cloud connection options configured under relevant menus. 2. Network Monitoring: Analyze your device's network traffic to verify it is not communicating with external cloud services. You can use monitoring tools to inspect traffic logs. 3. Disable Cloud Features: If the device has settings for connecting to cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, Alibaba, or MQTT, ensure these are disabled. 4. Documentation: Keep records of the measures you followed, such as screenshots of settings and network logs, to confirm the absence of cloud connections. Following these steps will help you demonstrate that cloud connectivity is not enabled or active on your device. Best regards
This information is exactly what I needed, thank you!

analysis.insight_summary: Users are focused on cyber security and want to ensure their [product_name] devices do not connect to any cloud services. They are seeking reliable verification methods and documentation to demonstrate the absence of cloud connectivity for compliance purposes.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect clear, practical guidance that enables them to prove—particularly for audit and compliance—that their [product_name] devices are not linked to any cloud services.
